component.name: AnyTone CPS
component.summary: Edit and export AnyTone D890UV codeplugs

description.p: AnyToneCPS is an open-source, cross-platform CPS (codeplug programming software) for the AnyTone D890UV DMR radio. It talks to the radio directly over its USB serial protocol - reverse-engineered from scratch against real hardware - so it does not depend on or wrap the vendor's Windows-only CPS.
